==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue start}}
:'''Shilang:''' Geez, I can finally take a breather now. Lately, I've been bombarded with people trying to sell me rocks...
:{{Icon|Tiger's Maw Ore Shop}} Tiger's Maw Ore
::(Open Shop)
:{{DIcon|Talk}} Rocks?
::'''Shilang:''' Yeah, because aside from selling ores, we're now buying them too.
::'''Shilang:''' People have been eager to sell the "ores" they found to us. Sadly, most of which was just worthless rocks.
::'''Shilang:''' That's why I thought, maybe we should team up with the Pioneer Association to create a special magazine issue about identifying ores.
::'''Shilang:''' We could give readers tips on how to distinguish them by colors, shine, and other traits. 
::'''Shilang:''' Mind giving me a few pointers after I finish the first draft?
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue end}}

; Dialogue after Player completes [[Alloy Smelt (Quest)]]
{{Dialogue start}}
:'''Shilang:''' Hmm, finally, some time to myself. Without the distractions from some dorky pumpkins trying to sell me useless rocks...
:{{DIcon|Side Quests}} About "Alloy Smelt"
::'''Shilang:''' Though I've been tweaking the recipe for my alloy, the progress of its improvement has always been limited.
::'''Shilang:''' I really can't compare myself with the academics and engineers at the academy who specialize in weapon materials.
::'''Shilang:''' But this crevice in the mine seems to have a special connection to my alloy.
::'''Shilang:''' Only my alloy glows near this crevice...
::'''Shilang:''' I was excited and scared at once.
::'''Shilang:''' Excited, because I felt my efforts were recognized, and my alloy was special in this Sonoro Sphere.
::'''Shilang:''' But I'm also scared that if the crevice disappears, will my alloy become meaningless?
::'''Shilang:''' Every time I think about this, I stop worrying about my business, and I even hope the crevice lasts a little longer...
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue end}}
